title: Sigma's 50-120mm f/2.8 Is the APS-C Zoom We've Been Waiting For
excerpt: Sigma's new 50-120mm f/2.8 gives APS-C shooters a 390-gram, $799 portrait-and-events zoom, completing an affordable constant-aperture trio.

title: Parents Are Using AI for School Photos Instead of Photographers
excerpt: Parents are using AI to turn plain-backdrop snapshots into school portraits, skipping the $25-$60 print package. 58% of U.K. photographers say they have lost commissioned work to AI.

title: A Free RAW Editor That Teaches You How to Edit
excerpt: Aftershoot launched Photon, a free RAW editor with an AI Coach that explains why each adjustment matters — built for photographers who shoot RAW but never learned what the sliders do.
